items.t: Said the legislature must come into special session and appropriate as many dollars as it can to feed children while waiting on the President and Congress to act.
items.q: We must come into a special session and appropriate as many dollars as we can to feeding our children while we wait on the President and Congress to act.

items.t: Said she wants every Oklahoman with disabilities to work in the best possible job for them, and that many people want to work and earn higher wages but face obstacles.
items.q: We want every Oklahoman with disabilities to work in the best possible job for them. ‎So many people want to work and make higher wages, but face obstacles to those jobs.

items.t: Claimed that a bill is largely political and will be used by Republicans on the campaign trail.
items.q: Senate Minority Leader Julia Kirt (D) claimed the bill is largely political and will be used by Republicans on the campaign trail, Oklahoma Voice reported.

record.t: Co-led the Rethinking Paying Subminimal Wage to Persons with Disabilities Task Force with Rep. Ellyn Hefner, which held its second meeting on April 24 at the Oklahoma State Capitol.
record.q: Rep. Ellyn Hefner, D-Oklahoma City and Senate Democratic Leader Julia Kirt, D-Oklahoma City are leading the Rethinking Paying Subminimal Wage to Persons with Disabilities Task Force

record.t: Served as the Senate principal author of HB 1833.
record.q: Senate Democratic Leader Julia Kirt is the Senate principal author of HB 1833.

record.t: Serves as co-chair of the Rethinking Paying Subminimal Wage to Persons with Disabilities Task Force, together with Rep. Hefner.
record.q: Kirt and Hefner will serve as co-chairs of the task force.
